newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends at a record high.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends at a record high.

text.p: UK's leading blue chip index scaled to a fresh record peak on Wednesday as investors shrugged off a pullback on Wall Street and a jump in UK retail sales that points to a rate hike, dealers and stategists said.
The FTSE 100 index added 25.1 points to close at its intraday high of 4,357.4. Advancers beat decliners 57 to 36.
